key_pathways: Protein therapeutic - cleared by reticuloendothelial system

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune function and potentially reduce etanercept efficacy or increase infection risk in immunosuppressed patients
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to avoid echinacea supplements during etanercept therapy

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May have immunostimulatory effects that could interfere with TNF-inhibitor therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to discontinue or avoid St. John's Wort during treatment

avoid_supplements.name: Interferon-alpha supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct immune stimulation opposing etanercept's immunosuppressive mechanism; increased infection and malignancy risk
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated - ensure patient awareness and avoid concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Generally safe but use with caution in severely immunocompromised patients; select non-pathogenic strains only
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects; discuss specific probiotic selection with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild immunomodulatory effects; supplementation reasonable for deficiency but monitor levels
caution_supplements.action: Check baseline 25-OH vitamin D level; supplement if deficient (monitor 25-OH vitamin D 25-50 ng/mL range)

caution_supplements.name: Zinc
caution_supplements.mechanism: Essential for immune function; deficiency may increase infection risk in immunosuppressed patients
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate dietary intake; supplementation reasonable if deficient but avoid excess (>40 mg/day)

avoid_foods.name: Raw/undercooked animal products (meat, eggs, shellfish)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increased pathogenic bacterial/viral contamination risk in immunocompromised patients receiving TNF-inhibitors
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on food safety: cook all animal products thoroughly; avoid raw oysters, sushi with raw fish, undercooked poultry

avoid_foods.name: Unpasteurized dairy products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Risk of Listeria monocytogenes and other pathogens in severely immunosuppressed etanercept patients
avoid_foods.action: Recommend only pasteurized dairy products; avoid raw milk cheeses and unpasteurized milk

avoid_foods.name: Unwashed fresh produce
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potential contamination with pathogenic organisms (E. coli, Listeria) in immunocompromised hosts
avoid_foods.action: Thoroughly wash all fresh fruits and vegetables; consider cooking produce when possible

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Etanercept may increase cardiovascular and fluid retention risk; excessive sodium can worsen these effects
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate sodium intake (<2,300 mg/day); monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Not a direct interaction but may affect concurrent medications (warfarin, statins) often used with etanercept patients
caution_foods.action: If consuming concurrent CYP3A4 substrates, limit grapefruit or monitor for interactions separately

monitoring_notes: Etanercept is a protein therapeutic not metabolized hepatically, so drug-drug interactions via cytochrome P450 are minimal. Primary concerns are immunosuppression-related infection risk from supplements and foods with pathogenic contamination; monitor for signs of infection (fever, persistent cough, unusual fatigue) and counsel extensively on food safety practices.
